items.heading: Thieboudienne
details: Key ingredients: rice, fish, tomato, vegetables
Stuff whole fish with a fragrant herb paste and fry lightly.
Simmer the fish with tomato and a mix of vegetables.
Cook rice in the rich, flavorful broth left behind.
Serve the rice topped with the fish and vegetables.

items.heading: Yassa Poulet
details: Key ingredients: chicken, onion, lemon, mustard
Marinate chicken in lemon juice, mustard and a generous amount of onion.
Grill or brown the chicken until golden.
Simmer the chicken with the marinated onions until soft and tangy.
Serve over rice with the sweet-sour onion sauce.

details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
